CONVEYOR SYSTEM PROBLEMS/CAUSES AND THEIR SOLUTIONS

symptom: Belt runs true when empty, crooked when loaded.

actions: adjust chute to place load on center of belt
discharge material in direction of belt travel at or near belt speed.

causes.cause: Variations in nature and formation of load
actions: use notched chute to keep load peak in exact center of belt.

causes.cause: Belt not making good contact with all idlers
actions: adjust height so all idlers contact belt.
